newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - July 22.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - July 22.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Indonesian stocks on Tuesday:
* On Monday, the Dow Jones industrial average rose 16.26 points to 7,906.72 as investors awaited earnings from IBM and congressional testimony from Federal Reserve Chairman Alan Greenspan on Tuesday.

* Indonesian central bank governor Soedradjad Djiwandono called on the people not to panic after the rupiah's steep falls against the dollar on Monday. He said the Indonesian people's purchasing power was not measured by the strengthening U.S. dollar, but by the domestic inflation rate.

* On Monday, the Jakarta composite index ended down 11.60 points, or 1.60 percent, at 712.40 points as sentiment turned cautious after the rupiah recorded its largest-ever single-day loss due to overseas speculative attacks, brokers said.
* On Tuesday, the rupiah was firmer against the dollar in early trade. It was traded at 2,605/15 at 0115 GMT against an opening of 2,633/43.
* Chemical firm Lautan Luas after a strong debut on Monday.
* Small-sized Bank Ficorinvest after announcement that privately-owned securities firm Bhakti Investama bought a 14.53 percent stake, worth some 40 billion rupiah, in the bank.
* Alumunium firm Indal after recent sharp rises on reports it planned to form a joint venture firm.
* Indosat on news that it has bought a 13-percent stake in telecommunications firm PT Pramindo Ikat Nusantara for $57.2 million.
* Transportation firm Mitra Rajasa on reports it planned to expand to air and sea transport ventures.
